messages:
Maya (Design): Quick heads-up — prototype for the immersive filter sheet is on staging. It pops up full-height on narrow widths and converts the results table to stacked mini-cards. looking for quick feedback on breakpoints and keyboard behavior. :eyes:
Samir (Product): Saw it — interesting pattern. My main worry is losing density for power users. At what width does the table -> cards switch? can we keep a compact table until 480px?
Elaine (Frontend): Current switch is at 460px in the prototype. CSS we used: 
```
@media (max-width: 460px) { .results-table { display: none } .mini-cards { display: block } }
```
Elaine (Frontend): Also the sheet steals focus and the on-screen keyboard covers the bottom action button on iOS. Need to test `inputmode` and ensure `safe-area-inset-bottom` support.
Maya (Design): Good call. UX intent was to make filters feel like a modal task flow on phones. If we move the switch to 520px we keep more density on phablets but the sheet may feel cramped. Thoughts on two-step: table -> compressed rows at 520, full cards at 420?
Jon (PM): +1 for a two-step. Most customers use iPhone 12/13/14 sizes; 520 seems reasonable for compressed rows. Also we need copy tweak: the sheet header currently says "Filters" — change to "Filter results" and add back-button label "Close filters" for screen readers.
Samir (Product): Agree on copy. Also, can we keep sort column visible as a floating pill while cards scroll? helps power users keep context.
Elaine (Frontend): Floating sort pill is doable — will add `position: sticky` on the header area of the results container. Need designer spec for spacing. Also plan to debounce resize so we don't toggle layout mid-scroll.
Maya (Design): I'll upload updated mock with spacing and sticky pill in figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xxx/immersive-filters — note: accessibility notes in the right panel. Key things: 1) focus trap on open, with explicit close. 2) announce "Filters opened" to screen readers. 3) ensure tab order: close -> applied chips -> actions.
Jon (PM): Can we also preserve selected row if user drills into a result then back, especially in card mode? product flow needs that.
Elaine (Frontend): We'll preserve selection via route state; should be fine. One accessibility nit: when switching from table -> cards we lost table semantics. Need `role="list"` and `role="listitem"` on cards and link semantics for titles.
Maya (Design): Good call. Also, reduce card padding slightly at 360px to avoid 2-line title wrap. I'll add a compact card style.
Samir (Product): One usability thing — the empty state under the sheet looks odd when keyboard is open. Could we push the sheet up slightly when keyboard opens instead of resizing content? Mobile Safari behavior is weird.
Elaine (Frontend): We'll implement keyboard-visible heuristics: listen for `window.visualViewport.height` changes and add `.keyboard-open` class to the sheet to adjust translateY. Will test on iOS 15/16.
DeployBot: preview/deploy created at https://staging.redwood.internal/immersive-filters — build 2026.03.22-9 :rocket:
Maya (Design): Great, thanks. Can folks try the staging on a physical iPhone (not simulator) and drop reactions here with screenshots if something jumps. I'll iterate based on keyboard and breakpoint results. :thumbsup:
Samir (Product): Will test on iPhone SE and Pixel 6. Leaving a couple quick notes: keep compact rows until 520, cards at <=420, floating sort pill by default, screen reader copy changes.
Elaine (Frontend): Noted. I'll send a small PR with the resize debounce and keyboard handling today.
Jon (PM): Marking this thread for the next design sync — Maya, can you add the figma link and the QA checklist to the ticket?
Maya (Design): Yup will add figma and QA items (breakpoints to test, keyboard, screen reader announcements, back-button label) to the ticket. Thanks everyone.
